描述_EN: this badge would have been worn on an overcoat for the court by an officer of the sixth rank, as indicated by use of egrets as a motif. this ming dynasty (1368-1644) rank badge is woven in the kesi tapestry technique, where colours are only woven on where the pattern requires, resulting in small gaps between woven patterns, giving the appearance of cut designs.
描述_ZN: 这个徽章应该是由六级官员穿在宫廷的大衣上的，正如使用白鹭作为图案所表明的那样。 这枚明代（1368-1644）的等级徽章是用凯西挂毯技术编织的，颜色只在图案需要的地方编织，导致编织的图案之间有小的空隙，给人以切割图案的感觉。
